uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: If at 50% max HP or below: grants this Pokémon a shield and increases their movement speed by 20% for 5s (45s CD). While at low HP, gain a shield and increased movement speed. (30s cooldown)

Becomes a boosted attack with increased range every third attack, hitting twice. The first hit damages opposing Pokémon with a normal basic attack; the second hit is a follow-up attack with a bone, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area a second time and throwing them for 0.5s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, performing a combo attack with a bone. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, performing a combo attack with a bone. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them.
Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. Has the user lunge forward at a speed that makes it almost invisible, dealing damage to enemies it comes in contact with.

Dashes forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit; restoring HP for each opposing Pokémon hit. If an auto attack is used at the end of the dash (0.2s after the move is used): attacks in a circle around them, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect with a unique auto attack. After learning this move: nearby opposing Pokémon have an Extreme Speed marker automatically applied to them. If this move's dash hits an opposing Pokémon: resets this move's cooldown; and removes the marker from the first target hit for 10s (or until applied by other moves). Charge forward with breathtaking speed. If this move hits an enemy from point-blank range, its cooldown is reset and it restores the user's HP. However, the cooldown cannot be continually reset by using this move on the same enemy multiple times in succession.
Increases the user's Attack by 7.5% for 2s when this move is used. Increases Attack for a short time when this move is used.

While held down: charges up power for up to 4s, reducing damage received by 30% and decreasing movement speed by 15%; reaches maximum charge after 1s. When released: dashes forward with a devastating punch, damaging the first opposing Pokémon hit, dealing additional missing HP damage to the target, and shoving them for 0.5s. Readies a boosted attack if this move hits. Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s each time one of their moves lands a hit. If not released after 4s or canceled, this move goes on a 1.4s cooldown. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1000. 12% of Enemy Missing HP (caps at 1000 dmg). Charges power before unleashing a powerful attack. While the user is charging power, its movement speed is decreased but its Attack slowly increases and the damage it receives is reduced. The user then charges in the designated direction and releases this move, dealing more damage the lower the enemies remaining HP is. The next basic attack becomes a boosted attack if the move hits. This move's cooldown is reduced every time one of the user's moves hits.
Becomes unstoppable while charging this move. Become immune to hindrances while charging power.

Punches with the force of a meteor in the designated direction after 0.4s, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and shoving them in the designated direction, stunning those hit for 0.4s. Blast forward with a punch like a comet, dealing damage to enemies and shoving them.

Rapidly strikes with a bone in the designated direction 3 times over 0.33s, damaging opposing Pokémon within melee range around Lucario, and in the area of the bone strikes in front; opposing Pokémon can be damaged twice per hit by being in the area where the bone strikes overlap with the attacks within melee range. Immediately after, throws the bone flying to land a short distance away, shoving opposing Pokémon in the way and stunning them for 0.4s. Cooldown starts upon first use. If used again within 3s of throwing the bone: dashes to the bone, then catches it, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon if the bone is grabbed. Landing one of the three initial strikes on opposing Pokémon applies an Extreme Speed marker to them. Performs a combo attack with a bone, dealing multiple damaging blows to enemies and shoving them. The final attack sends the bone flying. If used again while the bone is traveling, the user rushes to the location of the bone, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Catching the bone with the second use resets the cooldown of Extreme Speed or Power-Up Punch. Using this move again will reset the cooldown for Extreme Speed or Power-Up Punch.

Becomes unstoppable for 1.4s, and rapidly punches in the designated direction 11 times, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area in front of them with each hit; restoring HP each time this move hits. The rapid punches start 0.4s after the move is used, with the last punch hitting 1.2s after the start of the move. Changes the next basic attack used within 5s after using this move. This auto attack gains increased range and lunges at an opposing Pokémon with a kick, dealing damage. Unleash a combo attack, dealing multiple blows to enemies and shoving them.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

Becomes unstoppable for 0.6s and channels aura into a huge sphere, then launches the sphere in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. The aura sphere picks up speed as it travels; at close range, a target can be hit up to 4 times, while at max speed a target will only be hit once. If the user learned Extreme Speed: applies an Extreme Speed marker to targets hit by this Unite Move. If the user learned Power-Up Punch: strengthens the damage of the next attack of Power-Up Punch by roughly 20% and the shove duration to 1s when Power-Up Punch is released. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. Increases the damage dealt by the user's next Power-Up Punch after using this move.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Aura Cannon
source.originalDescription: Becomes unstoppable for 0.6s and channels aura into a huge sphere, then launches the sphere in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. The aura sphere picks up speed as it travels; at close range, a target can be hit up to 4 times, while at max speed a target will only be hit once. If the user learned Extreme Speed: applies an Extreme Speed marker to targets hit by this Unite Move. If the user learned Power-Up Punch: strengthens the damage of the next attack of Power-Up Punch by roughly 20% and the shove duration to 1s when Power-Up Punch is released. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. Increases the damage dealt by the user's next Power-Up Punch after using this move.
